Thanks Taylor — received the attachments and forwarding to AP for PO creation. A couple of notes / asks from procurement and tax: 

- We require a completed, signed W-9 (TIN confirmation) for all US entities before payment setup. The PDF looks scanned; can you confirm the signature page is the authorized signer?
- If the escrow is managed by a third party, our tax team sometimes requests a copy of the escrow agreement to confirm withholding responsibility. Can you share the escrow agent name and whether LedgerPay or the escrow agent will be the payee on the AP invoice?
- For PO processing we need vendor legal name to match W-9 exactly — please confirm the legal entity (as shown on the W-9) and the remit-to address.

I'll loop in Marcus from Finance and Priyom from Procurement to expedite the PO and confirm whether additional tax forms are needed.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Finance Partner, Procurement | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 14:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — initial tax docs and escrow question

Hi Taylor — Marcus here (Finance). Two quick items to keep things moving: 

1) W-9 validation: our vendor ops team will run the TIN/name match against IRS TIN matching. If the scanned signature page is the only signed evidence we can accept it, but we prefer a typed-and-signed PDF or DocuSign envelope for records. Could you resend a signed PDF where the signature line explicitly includes the signer's printed name and title?

2) Escrow handling: if LedgerPay will be listed as the payee on the invoice but funds are routed through an escrow agent, Redwood typically does not withhold taxes unless the escrow agent indicates withholding is required. We do, however, ask for the escrow agent contact and the escrow agreement excerpt that clarifies payer/payee responsibilities so our tax counsel can confirm.

I can provision a provisional PO (PO-7802) to unblock initial dev milestone payments pending final paperwork — that PO will be subject to final tax clearance. If you can get the signed W-9 (or DocuSign) and a one-page escrow summary over, we should be able to close within 3 business days.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Manager, Corporate Finance | Redwood Inference

- Escrow agent: ClearHarbor Trust — escrow agreement excerpt indicates LedgerPay is payee; ClearHarbor only facilitates disbursement per milestone cert. No withholding clause present.

If you want I can also push the DocuSign envelope to your procurement@redwood.com mailbox for system-of-record. Let us know and we'll add AP as a recipient.

Taylor
